name: Conch Fritters
desc: Chopped queen conch in a spiced batter, fried until golden and served with a dipping sauce nobody will give you the recipe for. Restores 180 HP.

name: Fish Rundown
desc: Fish simmered in coconut milk with onion, thyme and scotch bonnet until it falls apart. Cayman's slow, patient comfort food. Restores 200 HP.

name: Cassava Heavy Cake
desc: Grated cassava, sugar and coconut baked into a dense, sweet slab. It lives up to its name. Restores 160 HP.

name: Bucket of Squid
desc: Cleaned, chopped squid in a bucket. The smell is something you'll remember. Southern stingrays will cross a lagoon for it.

name: Silver Thatch Bracelet
desc: A bracelet woven from the silver thatch palm, the Cayman national tree. Caymanians have woven rope, baskets and hats from it for centuries.
msg: {name}'s Silver Thatch Bracelet turned the storm aside!
